udt_error_enum_v0.doc:
Error ranges reserved by dependencies.

| Range                    | Owner                       | Status                     |
|--------------------------|-----------------------------|----------------------------|
| `1..=15`                 | Stellar Asset Contract      | live \xe2\x80\x94 runtime (SAC calls) |
| `100..=114`              | OZ `FungibleTokenError`     | live \xe2\x80\x94 in wasm (LP token)  |
| `200..=211`, `300..=34x` | OZ non-fungible / RWA       | compiled, not in wasm      |
| `1000..=1501`            | OZ `stellar-contract-utils` | compiled, not in wasm      |
| `2000..=2202`            | OZ `stellar-access`         | not linked                 |
| `4000..=5012`            | OZ governance               | compiled, not in wasm      |

| Band     | Range       | What                               | Retriable                    | Fires normally |
|----------|-------------|------------------------------------|------------------------------|----------------|
| Input    | `x000\xe2\x80\x93x099` | Malformed input
udt_error_enum_v0.name: Error

cases.doc: A per-coin vector (constructor `tokens`/`asset_types`, or an `amounts`/`min_amounts`) is not\nexactly `COINS` long.
cases.name: InputCoinCountMismatch

cases.doc: Coin index is not in `0..COINS`.
cases.name: InputCoinIndexOutOfRange

cases.doc: A swap needs two different coins.
cases.name: InputDuplicateCoinIndex

cases.doc: The input amount is zero (vs `MarketLpRoundsToZero`, which is nonzero but too small).
cases.name: InputZeroAmount

cases.doc: A negative amount; the engine's arithmetic is unsigned.
cases.name: InputNegativeAmount

cases.doc: `fee` is outside `0..=MAX_FEE`.
cases.name: InputFeeOutOfRange

cases.doc: `admin_fee` is outside `0..FEE_DENOMINATOR`.
cases.name: InputAdminFeeOutOfRange

cases.doc: `offpeg_fee_multiplier` is unsupported or would make the dynamic fee exceed its maximum.
cases.name: InputOffpegMultiplierOutOfRange

cases.doc: Amplification is outside `1..MAX_A`.
cases.name: InputAmplificationOutOfRange

cases.doc: A ramp must run at least `MIN_RAMP_TIME`.
cases.name: InputRampDurationTooShort

cases.doc: A coin reports more decimals than `PRECISION_DECIMALS`.
cases.name: InputTooManyDecimals

cases.doc: The same token address appears more than once in the coin list.
cases.name: InputDuplicateCoinAddress

cases.doc: The payout receiver is the pool itself.
cases.name: InputReceiverIsPool

cases.doc: The pool named itself as the caller, which would spend or burn its own locked liquidity.
cases.name: InputCallerIsPool

cases.doc: The LP token's `name` or `symbol` is too long.
cases.name: InputMetadataTooLong

cases.doc: `min_locked_liquidity` is negative. Zero is legal and means the pool locks nothing.
cases.name: InputMinLockedLiquidityOutOfRange

cases.doc: Called before the constructor ran.
cases.name: StateNotInitialized

cases.doc: The operation needs liquidity, and the LP supply is zero.
cases.name: StateLpSupplyEmpty

cases.doc: A reserve is zero; the invariant is undefined there.
cases.name: StateReserveEmpty

cases.doc: A ramp was requested before `MIN_RAMP_TIME` elapsed since the last one.
cases.name: StateRampTooSoon

cases.doc: The ramp would change amplification by more than `MAX_A_CHANGE`\xc3\x97 from its current value.
cases.name: StateAmplificationChangeTooLarge

cases.doc: Reserves exceed the supported imbalance.
cases.name: StatePoolTooImbalanced

cases.doc: The stored Factory and salt do not derive this contract's address: not a Factory deployment.
cases.name: StateNotFactoryDeployed

cases.doc: Donations are disabled when the current spread and invariant checks pass.
cases.name: StateDonationNotNeeded

cases.doc: The caller would get less, or pay more, than the bound they set.
cases.name: MarketSlippageExceeded

cases.doc: A real input too small to mint or burn any LP; a larger one may succeed.
cases.name: MarketLpRoundsToZero

cases.doc: The LP burn exceeds total supply \xe2\x80\x94 a claim on more than the pool holds.
cases.name: MarketBurnExceedsSupply

cases.doc: The burner does not hold the LP being burned (vs `MarketBurnExceedsSupply`, the whole pool).
cases.name: MarketInsufficientLpBalance

cases.doc: The requested output or withdrawal exceeds what the coin reserve can pay; retry with less.
cases.name: MarketInsufficientLiquidity

cases.doc: Initial deposit is too small to fund the locked liquidity, a larger one may succeed.
cases.name: MarketInitialDepositTooSmall

cases.doc: A donation would put a coin's normalized balance (`xp`) above the prior pool maximum.
cases.name: MarketDonationAboveLimit

cases.doc: A coin's token rejected a transfer *into* the pool (payer's balance/allowance/trustline).
cases.name: ExtTokenPullFailed

cases.doc: A coin's token rejected a transfer *out of* the pool. Not the caller's fault; escalate.
cases.name: ExtTokenPushFailed

cases.doc: A coin's token gave an unusable response \xe2\x80\x94 trapped or undecodable. Its foreign error code is\ndiscarded, not re-raised.
cases.name: ExtTokenUnusable

cases.doc: A coin's token would not report usable `decimals`.
cases.name: ExtTokenBadMetadata

cases.doc: The bound Factory could not be reached to resolve admin / fee receiver.
cases.name: ExtFactoryUnavailable

cases.doc: A missing SAC trustline could not be opened.
cases.name: ExtTrustlineCreationFailed

cases.doc: This compatibility entrypoint is not implemented in this port.
cases.name: Unimplemented

cases.doc: This implementation supports only `ASSET_TYPE_PLAIN`, with no rate-oracle `methods` or `oracles`.

cases.doc: Newton iteration did not converge inside its cap; retry smaller.

cases.doc: Checked arithmetic overflowed or underflowed. Reserve exhaustion on a withdrawal is\n`MarketInsufficientLiquidity` (10304), not this \xe2\x80\x94 that condition is caught before the math.
cases.name: MathArithmetic

cases.doc: A postcondition this contract guarantees did not hold.
cases.name: Internal

cases.doc: Stored pool vectors disagree with this wasm's coin count.
cases.name: InternalReservesMalformed

cases.doc: The engine rejected the pool's own stored params (fee, `A`, admin fee, or rate).
cases.name: InternalStoredParamsInvalid

cases.doc: The LP token's `total_supply` diverged from the engine's `lp_supply`.
cases.name: InternalLpSupplyDrift

cases.doc: An engine value did not fit a host `i128`.
cases.name: InternalValueUnrepresentable

cases.doc: The planned transition would have lowered the invariant per LP token \xe2\x80\x94 LP principal leaking\nout. The engine's guardrail refused the plan; nothing was written.

function_v0.doc:
Sets the amount of tokens a `spender` is allowed to spend on behalf of
an `owner`. Overrides any existing allowance set between `spender` and
`owner`.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to Soroban environment.
* `owner` - The address holding the tokens.
* `spender` - The address authorized to spend the tokens.
* `amount` - The amount of tokens made available to `spender`.
* `live_until_ledger` - The ledger number at which the allowance
expires.

# Errors

* [`FungibleTokenError::InvalidLiveUntilLedger`] - Occurs when
attempting to set `live_until_ledger` that is less than the current
ledger number and greater than `0`.
* [`FungibleTokenError::LessThanZero`] - Occurs when `amount < 0`.

# Events

* topics - `["approve", from: Address, spender: Address]`
* data - `[amount: i128, live_until_ledger: u32]`

function_v0.doc:
Add liquidity: deposit `amounts` (one entry per coin) and mint LP to `receiver`, returning the LP minted.

On the first deposit every coin must be nonzero and the LP minted is the invariant `D`
itself; later deposits are charged the imbalance fee on the part of the deposit that shifts
the pool away from its current balance.

- `caller`: authorizes the call and pays the coins in.
- `amounts`: amount of each coin to deposit, one entry per coin.
- `min_mint`: slippage floor on the LP minted.
- `receiver`: credited the minted LP at its base address. LP balances are stored per
base address, so muxed IDs do not create separate on-chain LP positions. The optional
ID is preserved in the mint and liquidity events for off-chain attribution.

allowance mechanism. `amount` is then deducted from `spender`
allowance.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to Soroban environment.
* `spender` - The address authorizing the transfer, and having its
allowance consumed during the transfer.
* `from` - The address holding the tokens which will be transferred.
* `to` - The address receiving the transferred tokens.
* `amount` - The amount of tokens to be transferred.

# Errors

* [`FungibleTokenError::InsufficientBalance`] - When attempting to
transfer more tokens than `from` current balance.
* [`FungibleTokenError::LessThanZero`] - When `amount < 0`.
* [`FungibleTokenError::InsufficientAllowance`] - When attempting to
transfer more tokens than `spender` current allowance.

# Events

* topics - `["transfer", from: Address, to: Address]`
* data - `[amount: i128]`

Remove liquidity: burn `burn_amount` LP for a proportional, fee-free payout of every coin to `receiver`.

Pays out the same fraction \xe2\x80\x94 `burn_amount / lp_supply` \xe2\x80\x94 of every coin, so the pool's mix is
unchanged by the withdrawal. Nothing is charged.

- `caller`: authorizes the call and is charged the LP burn.
- `burn_amount`: LP-token amount being redeemed.
- `min_amounts`: slippage floor for each coin, one entry per coin.
- `receiver`: paid the coins.
Opens missing SAC trustlines with the receiver's authorization.
- `claim_admin_fees`: if `true`, also sweep the pool's accumulated admin fees to the Factory's
fee receiver in the same call

function_v0.name: offpeg_fee_multiplier

function_v0.doc:
Quote the amount of coin `i` received for burning `burn_amount` LP in a one-coin withdrawal,
withdrawal fee taken into account.

- `burn_amount`: LP-token amount being redeemed.
- `i`: index of the coin to withdraw.
function_v0.name: calc_withdraw_one_coin

function_v0.doc:
Withdraw a single coin `i` by burning LP, returning the coin amount paid out.

The burn shrinks the invariant pro-rata; the payout is the resulting drop in coin `i`,
reduced by the single-coin withdrawal fee.

- `caller`: authorizes the call and is charged the LP burn.
- `burn_amount`: LP-token amount being redeemed.
- `i`: index of the coin to withdraw.
- `min_received`: slippage floor on the coins out.
- `receiver`: paid the coins.
Opens missing SAC trustlines with the receiver's authorization.
function_v0.name: remove_liquidity_one_coin

function_v0.doc:
Withdraw an explicit, possibly imbalanced `amounts`, returning the LP actually burned.

The part of the withdrawal that shifts the pool away from its current balance is charged the
imbalance fee, so an imbalanced exit burns more LP than a balanced one of the same value.

- `caller`: authorizes the call and is charged the LP burn.
- `amounts`: amount of each coin to withdraw, one entry per coin.
- `max_burn`: slippage cap on the LP burned.
- `receiver`: paid the coins.
Opens missing SAC trustlines with the receiver's authorization.
function_v0.name: remove_liquidity_imbalance

event_v0.doc:
Event emitted when tokens are transferred between addresses without a
muxed destination.

Per SEP-41, the event data is a bare `i128` when no muxed address is
involved. The `data_format = "single-value"` attribute ensures the
`amount` field is serialized as a bare value rather than a map.
event_v0.name: Transfer

event_v0.doc:
Event emitted when tokens are transferred to a muxed address.

Per SEP-41, when the destination is a [`MuxedAddress`] the event data
carries both the amount and the muxed identifier so that off-chain
consumers can attribute the transfer to the correct sub-account.

Uses `topics = ["transfer"]` so that both [`Transfer`] and
[`MuxedTransfer`] share the same `"transfer"` event symbol, as required
by SEP-41.
event_v0.name: MuxedTransfer
